from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

from orca_task_sdk import run_orca

work = Path.cwd()
geom = work / "ethanol_initial.xyz"
if not geom.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError("missing staged geometry ethanol_initial.xyz")

inp = work / "job.inp"
inp.write_text("""! B3LYP 6-31G RKS TightSCF NORI NoAutoStart
%pal
  nprocs 4
end
%maxcore 192
%scf
  MaxIter 256
  ConvForced true
  AutoTRAH false
end
%geom
  MaxIter 128
  EnforceStrictConvergence true
end
%method
  Z_MaxIter 128
end
%output
  jsonpropfile
end
* xyzfile 0 1 ethanol_initial.xyz
""")

receipt = run_orca(str(inp), dependencies=(str(geom),), request_key="ethanol_opt_freq")
files = receipt.get("files", {})

def read_text(key):
    path = files.get(key)
    if not path:
        return None
    return Path(path).read_text(errors="replace")

stdout = read_text("stdout.out")
xyz_text = None
if "job.xyz" in files:
    xyz_text = Path(files["job.xyz"]).read_text(errors="replace").strip()

freqs = []
if stdout:
    lines = stdout.splitlines()
    start = 0
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "Vibrational frequencies" in line:
            start = i
    for line in lines[start:]:
        match = re.match(r"\s*\d+\s*:\s*([-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+cm\*\*-1", line)
        if match:
            freqs.append(float(match.group(1)))
    if not freqs:
        for line in lines[start:]:
            match = re.search(r"([-+]?\d+\.\d+)\s+cm\*\*-1", line)
            if match:
                freqs.append(float(match.group(1)))

observations = []
if xyz_text:
    observations.append({
        "name": "optimized_geometry",
        "value": {"xyz": xyz_text, "atom_count": int(xyz_text.splitlines()[0].strip())},
        "unit": None,
        "sources": [{
            "internal_request_key": receipt["request_key"],
            "filename": "job.xyz",
            "location": "final optimized geometry"
        }],
        "limitations": ["B3LYP/6-31G gas-phase geometry; no independent experimental validation."]
    })
if freqs:
    observations.append({
        "name": "vibrational_frequencies",
        "value": freqs,
        "unit": "cm^-1",
        "sources": [{
            "internal_request_key": receipt["request_key"],
            "filename": "stdout.out",
            "location": "ORCA vibrational frequency section"
        }],
        "limitations": ["Harmonic B3LYP/6-31G frequencies; no empirical scaling or experimental validation applied."]
    })

(work / "observations.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": 1, "observations": observations}, indent=2))
print(json.dumps({"request_key": receipt.get("request_key"), "operation_status": receipt.get("operation_status"), "files": sorted(files.keys()), "observations": [o["name"] for o in observations]}))
